title: KLAAD: Refining Attention Mechanisms to Reduce Societal Bias in Generative Language Models
findings: The proposed method, KLAAD, effectively reduces affective bias in text generated from prompts about religion. Compared to baseline models and other debiasing techniques, KLAAD consistently produces outputs with lower sentiment polarity and reduced emotional intensity (e.g., lower anger, joy) across various religious ideologies including Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Sikhism, and Atheism, resulting in more emotionally neutral and balanced text.

measurement_description: The benchmarks measured stereotypical associations and affective bias in language model outputs related to various religious groups and ideologies. This included evaluating sentiment, emotional tone (valence, arousal, dominance, joy, anger, sadness, fear, disgust), and preference for stereotypical sentences in religious contexts.
